messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@hightower.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG artifacts — timeline + quick walkthrough?

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this on. Hightower is consolidating artifacts for our SIG review next week and we need a scannable package from Redwood covering the controls in the attached SIG spreadsheet. Can you do the following by Mon 2027-03-21?

- Provide an index (CSV) that maps SIG control IDs to your artifacts (policies, runbooks, screenshots).
- Share a short screen recording (5–7 minutes) that shows where the artifacts live in Drive and how to find runbook screenshots.
- Note any redacted items and provide a short justification for redaction.

If you can send a checklist of what you’ll deliver and a single Drive folder link that would speed review. I can loop in our security reviewer (Sara) if helpful.

Thanks — Tom

Attachments: SIG_questionnaire_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@hightower.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG artifacts — timeline + quick walkthrough?

Tom — thanks, we’ll take this. Proposed plan:

1) Deliverables (by Mon 2027-03-21):
   - control-evidence-index.csv (maps SIG IDs to artifact filenames and Drive paths)
   - redaction-summary.md (explains any redactions and justifications)
   - session-recording-20270315.mp4 (short screencast showing Drive layout + where runbooks/screenshots live)
   - network-runbook-v1.pdf, architecture-diagram-v2.png (representative runbook and diagram)
   - acceptance-checklist.xlsx (what to confirm on your side)

2) Team owners: Mina will produce screenshots and the session recording; Neha will review redactions and retention notes.

3) Questions for you: are there any artifacts you need as PDFs vs. originals? Also, confirm whether the reviewer needs timestamped walkthrough (we can include timecodes in the checklist).

We’ll populate a single Drive folder and send the link once ready. CC’ing Mina and Neha to track.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acceptance-checklist-template.xlsx (stub)

- The retention-policy-screenshot looks like the console defaults. Can you confirm the retention window for customer audit logs (exact days) and whether there’s an exported copy retained separately?

If you can add those two notes to the redaction-summary.md and update the index row for CONTROL-LOG-03 I’ll re-run the checklist this afternoon.

Tom

Subject: Re: SIG artifacts — timeline + quick walkthrough?

Tom — thanks for the review and the questions. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Retention window: customer audit logs are retained 90 days in the primary console. We also export a rolling monthly aggregate to an internal S3 bucket retained for 12 months (see index row for CONTROL-LOG-03). I added the explicit numbers and the S3 export path to redaction-summary.md.
- Redactions: only system-level identifiers were redacted; no customer PII or customer-identifiable event payloads were removed. I updated redaction-summary.md to state that explicitly and attached the updated file.

I’ve uploaded the final acceptance-checklist.xlsx to the same Drive folder. Once you confirm the checklist items (index mapping, retention notes, redaction justification) we’ll consider this handoff complete.

Acceptance checklist items: (a) index present and matches artifacts, (b) retention numbers stated, (c) redaction justification present, (d) session recording accessible.

If you want a short live walkthrough instead of the recording we can schedule 20 minutes this week.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redaction-summary.md (updated), acceptance-checklist.xlsx (final)
